question: If I draw a card with miracle as the first card I draw this turn, do I have to reveal it and cast it for its miracle cost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you do not have to reveal a drawn card with miracle if you do not want to cast it at that time.
expected.answer: You don’t have to reveal a drawn card with miracle if you don’t wish to cast it at that time.
